# relay-cli

> AI-native CLI for Relay Protocol — cross-chain bridging and swaps across 69+ chains.

relay-cli dynamically generates commands from the Relay OpenAPI spec at runtime. New endpoints appear automatically without code changes.

## Agent Integration

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Integration guide — invocation contract, auth, safety tiers, error handling, gotchas
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude Code specific instructions — common workflows, safety rules, what not to do

## Machine-Readable Contracts

- [agents/tool-catalog.json](agents/tool-catalog.json): 29 commands with parameter schemas, types, and safety flags. Single source of truth for command discovery.
- [agents/error-catalog.json](agents/error-catalog.json): 9 error categories with retry strategies. Route on category, never parse message text.

## API Documentation

- [docs/relay-api-response-structures.md](docs/relay-api-response-structures.md): Field-by-field response documentation with cross-status comparisons and gotchas
- Relay docs: https://docs.relay.link
- Relay docs (LLM-optimized): https://docs.relay.link/llms.txt
- OpenAPI spec: https://api.relay.link/documentation/json (954KB, auto-cached by CLI for 24h)
